message.content: {"decision":"accept","reason":"This GitHub blog post introduces ReviewBench, a new open benchmark for AI code review agents that is rigorously constructed with multi-source ground truth, expert validation, and metrics aligned to real-world pull requests. It provides concrete evidence about how AI reviewers can be evaluated for strengths and weaknesses, which helps learners understand what kinds of code review tasks AI agents can reliably assist with and how to choose among them.
